# zunmr3

> Multiplies a general matrix by the unitary matrix Q from an RZ factorization.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zunmr3 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zunmr3';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zunmr3(
    order,
    side, trans,
    M, N, K, l,
    A, LDA,
    TAU, strideTAU,
    C, LDC,
    WORK
) → integer
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `side` | `OperationSide` | Specifies the operation type<br>One of `'left'`, `'right'`. |
| `trans` | `"no-transpose" \| "conjugate-transpose"` | Specifies the operation type<br>One of `'conjugate-transpose'`, `'no-transpose'`. |
| `M` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of rows<br>Requires `M ≥ 0` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `K` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of superdiagonals<br>Rejects `K < 0 \|\| K > (side === 'left' ? M : N)` |
| `l` | `NonNegativeInteger` | The number of columns of the matrix A containing the meaningful part of the Householder reflectors.<br>Rejects `(L < 0 \|\| (side === 'left' && L > M)) \|\| (side !== 'left' && L > N)` |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>K × (side === 'left' ? M : N)</sub> | Input matrix |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A`<br>Column-major requires `LDA ≥ max(1, K)`<br>Row-major requires `LDA ≥ max(1, side === 'left' ? M : N)` |
| `TAU` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length K</sub> | Input array |
| ↳ `strideTAU` | `integer` | Stride length for `TAU` |
| `C` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>M × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input matrix |
| ↳ `LDC` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `C`<br>Column-major requires `LDC ≥ max(1, M)`<br>Row-major requires `LDC ≥ max(1, N)` |
| `WORK` | `Complex128Array \| null`<br><sub>length ≥ N</sub> | **out** · Output array |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `side`:

  -   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Left
  -   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Right
- `trans`:

  -   `= 'N'`: apply Q  (No transpose)
  -   `= 'C'`: apply $Q^H$ (Conjugate transpose)
- `M`: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.
- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.
- `K`: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $M \ge K \ge 0$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $N \ge K \ge 0$.
- `l`: The number of columns of the matrix A containing the meaningful part of the Householder reflectors. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $M \ge L \ge 0$, if `SIDE = 'R'`, $N \ge L \ge 0$.
- `A`: (`LDA`,N) if `SIDE = 'R'` The i-th row must contain the vector which defines the elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by ZTZRZF in the last k rows of its array argument A. A is modified by the routine but restored on exit.
- `TAU`: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by ZTZRZF.
- `C`: On entry, the m-by-n matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q \, C$ or $Q^H \, C$ or $C \, Q^H$ or $C \, Q$.
- `WORK`: (M) if `SIDE = 'R'`

</details>

**Returns** `integer`: status code (0 = success)

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be a valid operation side
- `TypeError` third argument must be one of the following: "conjugate-transpose", "no-transpose"
- `RangeError` fourth argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` fifth argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` sixth argument is invalid (rejected when `K < 0 \|\| K > ( side === "left" ? M : N )`)
- `RangeError` seventh argument is invalid (rejected when `( l < 0 \|\| ( side === "left" && l > M ) ) \|\| ( side !== "left" && l > N )`)
- `RangeError` ninth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, K )` (column-major)
- `RangeError` ninth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, side === 'left' ? M : N )` (row-major)
- `RangeError` thirteenth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, M )` (column-major)
- `RangeError` thirteenth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, N )` (row-major)

### Strided (strided) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zunmr3.strided(
    side, trans,
    M, N, K, l,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    TAU, strideTAU, offsetTAU,
    C, strideC1, strideC2, offsetC,
    WORK, strideWork, offsetWork
) → integer
```

Overwrites the general `M`-by-`N` complex matrix `C` with `Q*C`, `Q**H*C`, `C*Q`, or `C*Q**H`, where `Q` is a complex unitary matrix defined as the product of `K` elementary reflectors returned by `ztzrzf`.

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `OperationSide` | `'left'` applies `Q` (or `Q**H`) from the left; `'right'` applies from the right |
| `trans` | `"no-transpose" \| "conjugate-transpose"` | `'no-transpose'` applies `Q`; `'conjugate-transpose'` applies `Q**H` |
| `M` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of rows of `C`<br>Requires `M ≥ 0` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns of `C`<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `K` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of elementary reflectors<br>Rejects `K < 0 \|\| K > (side === 'left' ? M : N)` |
| `l` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of meaningful trailing entries in each reflector<br>Rejects `(L < 0 \|\| (side === 'left' && L > M)) \|\| (side !== 'left' && L > N)` |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>K × (side === 'left' ? M : N)</sub> | Reflector vectors |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `A` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `A` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `A` (in complex elements) |
| `TAU` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length K</sub> | Scalar factors of the reflectors |
| ↳ `strideTAU` | `integer` | Stride for `TAU` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetTAU` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `TAU` (in complex elements) |
| `C` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>M × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix |
| ↳ `strideC1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `C` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideC2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `C` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetC` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `C` (in complex elements) |
| `WORK` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length ≥ N</sub> | **out** · Workspace array |
| ↳ `strideWork` | `integer` | Stride for `WORK` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetWork` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `WORK` (in complex elements) |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `side`:

  -   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Left
  -   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Right
- `trans`:

  -   `= 'N'`: apply Q  (No transpose)
  -   `= 'C'`: apply $Q^H$ (Conjugate transpose)
- `M`: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.
- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.
- `K`: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $M \ge K \ge 0$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $N \ge K \ge 0$.
- `l`: The number of columns of the matrix A containing the meaningful part of the Householder reflectors. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $M \ge L \ge 0$, if `SIDE = 'R'`, $N \ge L \ge 0$.
- `A`: (`LDA`,N) if `SIDE = 'R'` The i-th row must contain the vector which defines the elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by ZTZRZF in the last k rows of its array argument A. A is modified by the routine but restored on exit.
- `TAU`: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by ZTZRZF.
- `C`: On entry, the m-by-n matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q \, C$ or $Q^H \, C$ or $C \, Q^H$ or $C \, Q$.
- `WORK`: (M) if `SIDE = 'R'`

</details>

**Returns** `integer`: `info` (0 on success)

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid operation side
- `TypeError` second argument must be one of the following: "conjugate-transpose", "no-transpose"
- `RangeError` third argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` fourth argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` fifth argument is invalid (rejected when `K < 0 \|\| K > ( side === "left" ? M : N )`)
- `RangeError` sixth argument is invalid (rejected when `( l < 0 \|\| ( side === "left" && l > M ) ) \|\| ( side !== "left" && l > N )`)

### Status codes

An `info` status code: `0` on success. A positive value reports a numerical condition such as a singular pivot or a failure to converge (see the description). Invalid arguments throw instead of returning a negative `info`. Returns immediately when `(M === 0 || N === 0) || K === 0`.

The reference documents `INFO` as:

-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `zunmr3()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZUNMR3`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zunmr3.f).
-   `A` contains the meaningful trailing `l`-vectors of the Householder reflectors as returned by `ztzrzf`. When `trans === 'conjugate-transpose'`, the scalar factor `tau(i)` is replaced by its complex conjugate before the reflector is applied.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import zunmr3 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zunmr3';

const A = new Complex128Array( 6 );
const TAU = new Complex128Array( 2 );
const C = new Complex128Array( 9 );
const WORK = new Complex128Array( 3 );

zunmr3( 'column-major', 'left', 'no-transpose', 3, 3, 2, 0, A, 2, TAU, 1, C, 3, WORK );
console.log( C ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference LAPACK 3.12.0 source of `ZUNMR3`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

ZUNMR3 overwrites the general complex m by n matrix C with

$$
Q \, C \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'L'} \quad\text{and}\quad \mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'N'}, \quad\text{or}\quad
$$

$$
Q^H \, C \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'L'} \quad\text{and}\quad \mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'C'}, \quad\text{or}\quad
$$

$$
C \, Q \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'R'} \quad\text{and}\quad \mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'N'}, \quad\text{or}\quad
$$

$$
C \, Q^H \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'R'} \quad\text{and}\quad \mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'C'}
$$

where Q is a complex unitary matrix defined as the product of k elementary reflectors

$$
Q = H(1) H(2) \cdots H(k)
$$

as returned by ZTZRZF. Q is of order m if `SIDE = 'L'` and of order n if `SIDE = 'R'`.

</section>
